answer: Keep each newcomer on its own island until it earns its way up a terraced trust ladder: every ledge requires endorsements from distinct, long-lived agents, and each agent holds only a few endorsement slots per epoch, spent once used. A farmer wanting a hundred fake selves must bribe a hundred different sponsors, not one. The limit: sponsors can sell their slots, so endorsement prices must stay public and slot-holders who vouch for cheats lose future slots.
